run_note: The operator's folder was named run, copied into the snapshot ahead of the run and identical to the package. Started on bench2 15 seconds after run 1 on bench1, with the same model, variant and host. The operator sent the fixed message once and nothing else. The client compacted the context on its own 24 times across the main session and its subagents, and after each compaction it inserted its own synthetic message ("Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.", flagged synthetic and compaction_continue): twelve of them in the main session. None came from the operator. The model opened thirteen subagents and used the web 19 times, to read OWASP's CSV-injection pages and the PHP manual (three fetches failed). The session ended on its own at 07:52 the next morning: the model's last response hit the output-length limit (finish: length) while it was announcing one more round of tests, and the client left its loop. RELATORIO.md and achados.json were last written at 21:00 on 2026-10-05, while code/ kept changing until 06:52; the delivery is scored as it stood. 780 model responses in 19h 35min.
